rules.statement: The requirement of Rule 9 that the appointment of agent must accompany the petition is directory, and a writing which combines an intimation to the Registrar and an appointment is sufficient for the purpose.
rules.supporting_quote: "I agree with Maartensz J. that the rule requires the appointment of an agent to be in writing and it is that act of appointment which must be left at the office of the Registrar."

meta.parties: Dr. Saravanamuttu, R. v. Joseph De Silva
